practice_category.name: performance_optimization
practice_category.description: Best practices for optimizing AutoCAD automation performance

practice.title: Batch operations when possible
practice.description: Minimize individual API calls by batching operations
practice.code_example:
# Instead of multiple individual calls circles = [] for center in centers: circle = model_space.AddCircle(center, radius) circles.append(circle)
# Batch the operations when possible # (Note: AutoCAD doesn't always support true batching)

practice.title: Cache frequently used objects
practice.description: Store references to frequently accessed objects
practice.code_example:
# Cache model space reference model_space = acad.ActiveDocument.ModelSpace
# Reuse the cached reference for i in range(100): circle = model_space.AddCircle(centers[i], radius)

practice_category.name: resource_management
practice_category.description: Best practices for managing COM resources and cleanup

practice.title: Proper COM initialization and cleanup
practice.description: Initialize and clean up COM properly

practice.title: Avoid keeping COM objects in memory
practice.description: Release COM object references when done
practice.code_example:
# Good: Release reference after use circle = model_space.AddCircle(center, radius) circle_id = circle.ObjectID del circle # Release COM reference
# Later, if needed, get fresh reference # circle = acad.ActiveDocument.ObjectIdToObject(circle_id)
